name: forks
description: Type anything and watch the line of GitHub repositories it came from grow — every point a real repo, checked against GitHub. Launch a pump.fun coin on any repository, its creator fees split for good to the people who wrote the code. Plus $FORK trials with sign-in with X.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.js netlify/functions/*.mjs netlify/lib/*.mjs scripts/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
